title: Render finite temperature and humidity pages through one Face Mask
body:
The climate appliance needs alternating Fahrenheit and relative-humidity pages derived from one immutable semantic Face. Page timing and the fractional marker are Mask/Look policy, while physical annunciator availability belongs to the hardware profile.

Scope: add a finite prepared timed seven-segment Mask and an explicit colon fractional-marker Look. Preserve tenths, actual wiring validation, Face provenance and terminal lifetime behavior. Do not add acquisition, timers, GPIO effects, runtime scheduling or Body membership to the renderer.

Acceptance: alternate temperature/RH from the same Face at explicit elapsed times; refuse zero timing bounds; show unavailable after the admitted lifetime; support the actual colon-only profile without claiming bottom decimal points exist. Existing decimal-point Looks and Mask tests remain passing. This portable rendering step is not proof of native scheduling or appliance deployment.
